extraction.Name: Zoe Utterback
extraction.Recorded patent: On January 9, 1919, Belvidere State Bank recorded the patent.
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: conveyed the land by deed to James E. Utterback for $1.00 and other valuable consideration
extraction.Buyer: James E. Utterback for $1.00 and other valuable consideration
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 612706 issued; land described as Lot 1, Section 5, Lots 1, 2, 3 and 4, section 7, East half of Southeast quarter section 6, Lot 1 and East half of Northeast quarter and Southwest quarter of Northeast quarter, section 7, west half of northwest quarter and Northeast quarter of Northwest quarter, section 8, township 44, and Lot 2, section 32, and lots 1 and 2, section 33, township 45, range 32; receipt for patent signed February 28, 1918 by the allottee; conveyance dated December 28, 1918; Zoe Utterback identified as wife of James E. Utterback
